1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is formulated for delivery to an oil and gas reservoir__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __selected from zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, or zirconium acetylacetonate__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine __having a molecular weight of less than 2000 Da__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, __wherein said composition is formulated for controlled release in an oil and gas reservoir environment__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __wherein said nanoparticle provides controlled release of said crosslinker in an oil and gas reservoir__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, __wherein said composition is stable in field brine having a salinity greater than seawater__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex [[comprised]] __comprises__ a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter __and is formulated for injection into an oil and gas reservoir__.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater __and provide controlled release functionality in reservoir conditions__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __of less than 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron __and formulated for delivery to an oil and gas reservoir__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __for controlled release in an oil and gas reservoir environment__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al __wherein said nanoparticle provides delayed release of said multivalent cation in reservoir conditions__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer [[thai]] __that__ can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid __wherein said delayed gelling composition is formulated for injection into an oil and gas reservoir__.

22) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer __having anionic sites available for crosslinking__.

23) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __having a degree of hydrolysis sufficient to provide crosslinking sites__.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or __N,N-dimethylacrylamide__.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where [[fluid]] __said fluid__ is brine or seawater __having a salinity suitable for oil and gas reservoir operations__.
